text.tspan: Both arms: same 10,000-step trapezoid, same 500-step validation
grid, 491,520 tokens/step. Each against a no-DiLoCo run of that
config on its own box; the two references agree to within 0.016.

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; fill: rgb(85, 85, 85); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: The reference curve inverted. Rounds before ~1B tokens are worse
than anything the reference logged, so no ratio is defined.
Dotted: both arms run the same 10,000-step schedule, but the
reference first reached these losses around step 3,400-4,200,
well before its own warmdown. A warmed-down DiLoCo point is
matched to a pre-warmdown reference point, which flatters
DiLoCo — 3.41× is the last clean K=8 value.
